def test_monotonic():
    # strictly increasing
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == True
    # strictly decreasing
    assert monotonic([5, 4, 3, 2, 1]) == True
    # non-strictly increasing with duplicates
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 2, 3, 4]) == True
    # non-strictly decreasing with duplicates
    assert monotonic([5, 4, 4, 2, 1]) == True
    # all equal - both increasing and decreasing
    assert monotonic([2, 2, 2, 2]) == True
    # not monotonic
    assert monotonic([1, 3, 2, 4]) == False
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 5, 3, 4]) == False
    # edge cases
    assert monotonic([]) == True
    assert monotonic([1]) == True
    assert monotonic([1, 1]) == True
    assert monotonic([2, 1]) == True
    # negative numbers and floats
    assert monotonic([-3, -2, -1, 0]) == True
    assert monotonic([3.5, 2.1, 0.5]) == True
    assert monotonic([1.1, 2.2, 1.1]) == False
